entry.title: How to Back Up Self-Hosted Spliit: PostgreSQL Dumps, S3 Receipts and a Docker Restore That Loses Nothing

Capture all three on the same schedule, keep one copy off the machine that runs the containers, and restore them in that order onto a Spliit image of the same minor version.
